metadata.description: Agent skills for Lean Thinking and Toyota Production System methods, by Art Smalley — author of Four Types of Problems, Understanding A3 Thinking, Creating Level Pull, and Toyota Kaizen Methods.

plugins.name: tbp-coach
plugins.description: Toyota Business Practices 8-step problem-solving coach, by Art Smalley. Coaches you through your own real problem one step at a time — asks questions, never solves it for you.

plugins.name: five-why-coach
plugins.description: 5 Why root cause analysis coach, by Art Smalley. Drills one causal chain one why at a time, demanding evidence and a verification method at every link — never supplies the causes or the root cause.

plugins.name: fishbone-coach
plugins.description: Fishbone (Ishikawa) cause-and-effect coach, by Art Smalley. Structured hypothesis mapping across categories — not brainstorming — with branch-by-branch causal rigor and prioritization for verification.

plugins.name: claude-usage-review
plugins.description: Review how a person actually uses Claude Code, Cowork, or claude.ai, score it on a 1-10 maturity scale (plus an off-scale 11), and give 1-3 concrete next moves. Mines local evidence when run in Claude Code; interviews otherwise.
